<noinclude>
Template for displaying safety certification information in a standardized format.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Safety Certification
|name=Biosafety Level 2
|type=Biosafety
|issuing_body=Institutional Biosafety Committee
|issue_date=2024-01-15
|expiry_date=2026-01-15
|validity_period=2 years
|required_for_equipment=[[Equipment:Confocal Microscope]]
|required_for_protocol=[[Protocol:Cell Culture Protocol]]
|personnel_with_certification=[[Personnel:Jane Smith]]; [[Personnel:John Doe]]
|status=Active
}}
</pre>

== Parameters ==
* name - Certification name (required)
* type - Certification type (Biosafety, Radiation Safety, Chemical Safety, etc.)
* issuing_body - Organization that issued the certification
* issue_date - Issue date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* expiry_date - Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* validity_period - How long the certification is valid
* required_for_equipment - Semicolon-separated list of equipment links
* required_for_protocol - Semicolon-separated list of protocol links
* personnel_with_certification - Semicolon-separated list of personnel links
* status - Status (Active, Expired, Revoked)

[[Category:Template]]
</noinclude>
